description: Every token a Solana wallet holds, valued in USD: SOL and all fungible SPL and Token-2022 balances with symbol, name, amount, price and value, sorted by value, plus the total portfolio value and the NFT count. One call instead of dozens of RPC reads. Price: 0.005 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"solana_portfolio"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/crypto/portfolio?address=CWfaj5vDppWCp4q1X4iPYGWpCGY2Rerj9DQWqxTnz1Pp
